title: Poliomyélite : intensification de l’Initiative mondiale pour l’éradication de la poliomyélite : rapport du Secrétariat

toc.title: MESURES À PRENDRE PAR LE CONSEIL EXÉCUTIF

sections.title: Front matter

summary.text: A WHO Executive Board report (EB130/19, December 2011) on intensifying the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, prepared in response to resolution WHA61.1. It reviews progress under the 2010–2012 strategic plan as assessed by the Independent Monitoring Board, including the situation in endemic and re-infected countries and the funding gap. It also outlines planning for the polio endgame, including a switch from trivalent to bivalent oral vaccine in routine immunization and possible introduction of inactivated polio vaccine, with expert recommendations due in 2012.

sections.title: MESURES À PRENDRE PAR LE CONSEIL EXÉCUTIF

summary.text: Presents the draft resolution the Executive Board is invited to recommend to the Sixty-fifth World Health Assembly on intensifying polio eradication. The preambular paragraphs recall earlier resolutions and the risks posed by continued transmission, and the operative paragraphs declare completion of eradication a programmatic emergency for global public health. It urges Member States to act and financing to be secured, and asks the Director-General to plan the endgame strategy through 2018 and to report to future Health Assemblies.
